name: Question 2
problem:
What is the minor of ${x}_{33}$ in 
$X=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 & 3 \\ 2 & 1 & -1 & 5 \\ 1 & 4 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]?$
worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${x}_{33}$, we remove the $3$rd row and $3$rd column:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & ∗ & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & ∗ & 3 \\ ∗ & ∗ & -1 & ∗ \\ 1 & 4 & ∗ & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{33}=|\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 3 & 3 \\ 1 & 4 & -2\end{aligned}|.
$$

What is the minor of x33 in X=[−2010−131321−15141−2]?

a
|01031341−2|

|3131−1541−2|

EXPLANATION

To get the minor of x33, we remove the 3rd row and 3rd column:

X=[−20∗0−13∗3∗∗−1∗14∗−2]

So, the minor is

M33=|−200−13314−2|.
